Container.Name: towercab
Container.Overview: Live aircraft around an airport in a 3D scene, like the view from the tower cab, in a browser. Traffic comes from public ADS-B services or your own receiver. Works with no tokens at all (Schematic mode); a free Cesium ion token adds photorealistic 3D tiles and terrain. Not for navigation or operational use.

Config.Name: Web interface
Config.Description: Port for the web page and its WebSocket. Point your reverse proxy at this.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Holds config.yaml (airports, data sources, cameras). The example config is copied here on first start; edits are picked up while the container runs.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Downloaded airport data, the camera queue, and your own aircraft models and recordings.

Config.Name: Cesium ion token
Config.Description: Optional. A free Cesium ion access token switches on photorealistic 3D tiles and terrain. It is sent to browsers by design: restrict it to your hostname in the ion dashboard (Access Tokens, Allowed URLs).

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional. The address people use to reach TowerCab through your reverse proxy, e.g. https://towercab.example.com

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for log times, e.g. America/Indiana/Indianapolis

Config.Name: Admin token
Config.Description: Optional. A long random string that switches on the /admin page (camera queue, discovery, camera poses). Leave empty and the admin page does not exist.

Config.Name: Google Maps API key
Config.Description: Optional alternative to the ion token for photorealistic 3D tiles: a Google Maps Platform key with the Map Tiles API enabled. Sent to browsers by design: restrict it to your website in the Google Cloud console.

Config.Name: adsb.lol API key
Config.Description: Optional. Without a key adsb.lol allows 500 requests a day, which TowerCab paces itself to stay inside.

Config.Name: OpenSky client id
Config.Description: Optional. OpenSky Network API client id, for the fallback source (enable opensky in config.yaml).

Config.Name: OpenSky client secret
Config.Description: Optional. OpenSky Network API client secret.

Config.Name: YouTube API key
Config.Description: Optional. YouTube Data API v3 key, used only when you search for cameras on the admin page.

Config.Name: Windy API key
Config.Description: Optional. Windy Webcams API key, for searching webcams on the admin page and showing them.

Config.Name: Port inside the container
Config.Description: The port the server listens on inside the container. Leave it at 8790 unless you run the container on the host network; the port mapping above must point at the same number.
